dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit a high-contrast transition from the dark primary substrate to high-intensity light perimeters. These light perimeters enclose darker, low-intensity focal centers with irregular, jagged edge geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of light-intensity pixel clusters is observed across the dorsal-central region. The core pixel concentration is highest in the mid-upper section, with clusters becoming more isolated and less defined towards the lower and posterior visible boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent 'O' rings in the upper-central quadrant form an irregular convex quadrilateral. A secondary triad of light-intensity blobs located near the posterior-dorsal curve forms a scalene triangle.
